definitions.fresh: Fresh Chrome profile on an already-running server, cached local assets and compiled/restored model; machine, driver and OS caches not cleared.
definitions.warm: Second navigation of the same browser profile/tab and server; texture payload remains cached per model version.
definitions.payload: Same external cache-miss timing wrapper on both sources; process CPU includes other threads. Separate warm rebuild is a new hub, not an existing cache hit.
definitions.draw: Forty synchronous renders plus GPU pixel readback per view; independent one-second RAF sample; desktop1280x800 DPR1.
definitions.memory: Process-tree RSS can count shared pages repeatedly; not GPU VRAM. The1MiB cap is base RGBA data; mipmaps and sampler/source bookkeeping have additional cost.
definitions.video: Paused physics, actual full browser camera motion screencast; not an autonomous locomotion demonstration.

formal_budget.coverage: Exactly one unchanged full install/viewer run; other benchmark sections not run; no stable idle-CPU upper bound or general speedup claim.

media.definition: Complete actual screencast timestamps retained; physics paused, camera moves. Stream-copy concatenations add no synthetic frames. Full decode checks all frames; contact images are sampled visual inspection only.

scope.name: Bounded native RGB/RGBA image detail for imported/library/composed meshes with authored UVs
scope.tests: 607 distinct scoped cases plus7 unchanged framework cases; complete default suite not rerun
scope.performance: ANYmal first complete view costs+122.5/+131.5ms; paired Chrome process-tree RSS+4.16–26.06MiB; mixed frame/loading samples retained. One official install/viewer run passes11 measured budgets.
scope.limits: Base RGBA cap is not GPU VRAM. Global legacy sRGB convention does not implement explicit-linear image parity. Sampled visual inspection; paused-physics camera videos; no phone/Windows/other-driver certification.
scope.next: Durable named layout save/restore for creative map exploration, separate from transient Undo and live physics snapshots.
